about.title: About Husain Law
text: Houston is home to one of the nation’s best personal injury law firms — Husain Law and Associates Truck Accident Lawyers.

Accomplished Texas attorney Nomaan K. Husain established Husain Law and Associates Truck Accident Lawyers to help victims of the negligence of others in motor vehicle accidents, aviation accidents, and incidents resulting in fatal injuries, amounting to wrongful death. He has assembled a “dream team” of dynamic associates who share his dedication and compassion.

Look to our Houston law offices for advocacy in these practice areas: accidents causing traumatic injuries to the brain and spinal cord, aviation accidents in the United States and Europe, driving accidents caused by texting and driving, assistance for client families whose relatives were victims of wrongful death, and corporate immigration.
